items.title: This app is a helper — the game is on the table
items.detail: You move plastic 'Mechs by hand. The phone tells you whose turn it is, does the shooting math, and tracks damage. It is not a video game.

items.title: Optional: download the free Quick-Start PDF
items.detail: You can play Ridge Line with just this app. The official Alpha Strike Quick-Start PDF is extra reading if you want it.

items.title: Get four miniatures and their cards
items.detail: Ridge Line uses Shadow Hawk + Commando vs Wolverine + Locust. Each model has a card with its numbers (Move, Armor, Structure).

items.title: Get two six-sided dice
items.detail: Whenever the app asks, roll the dice on the table, then type what you rolled. (You can also let the app roll if you forgot dice.)

items.title: Get a measuring tape that shows inches
items.detail: Measure from the edge of one miniature’s base to the edge of the other — not the centers.

items.title: Clear a table about 3 feet across
items.detail: Two box maps side by side is perfect. A kitchen table works too.

items.title: Then tap Play Ridge Line
items.detail: The app loads both sides for you. One player is Side A, the other is Side B. Sit so you can both see the phone.
